relations.note: Prometheus forms Veritas from clay, fires her, and gives her life.
relations.source: Phaedrus, Appendix Perottina, Prometheus et Dolus

relations.note: Dolus secretly copies Veritas but lacks enough clay to give his counterfeit feet.
relations.source: Phaedrus, Appendix Perottina, Prometheus et Dolus

relations.note: Veritas walks after animation while her counterfeit Mendacium remains immobile.
relations.source: Phaedrus, Appendix Perottina, Prometheus et Dolus

relations.note: Jupiter summons Prometheus away, indirectly enabling Dolus to counterfeit Veritas.
relations.source: Phaedrus, Appendix Perottina, Prometheus et Dolus

relations.note: An unnamed old poet calls Truth the daughter of Time.
Greek Alatheia is invoked as Zeus's daughter, later transferred to Veritas.
Pindar jointly invokes the Muse and Alatheia to correct delayed praise.
Repentance turns tearfully toward Truth as Truth approaches the allegorical procession.
Truth approaches behind Calumny's procession as its compositional and moral opposite.
Truth approaches the allegorical scene in opposition to Envy and Calumny's attendants.
Truth approaches the allegorical scene in opposition to Fraud attending Calumny.
Truth approaches the allegorical scene in opposition to Conspiracy attending Calumny.
Truth approaches the allegorical scene opposing the deception encouraged by Ignorance.
Truth approaches the allegorical scene opposing the deception encouraged by Suspicion.
Faith and naked Truth jointly search for anyone equal to the dead Quintilius.
Modesty and naked Truth jointly search for anyone equal to the dead Quintilius.
Later mythographers made Saturn her father by equating him with Time.
